generation.scope: The entire Walsh presentation family belongs to the known fifteen-dimensional unrestricted component. A smooth shared ordinary rank-fifteen point has twenty transverse points and twenty independent conormal identities. The local unmarked quotient at a general Walsh point has three trivial transverse coordinates and twelve one-dimensional nontrivial characters. Four distinct reduced period-two germs leave the Walsh family, of dimensions nine, five, five, five; their geometric generic points are standard AS and the remaining general deformation has period four.

open_mathematics: Finish the unmarked filter for special symmetric points. Extend the positive-dimensional-edge and the non-Walsh period-two deformation analyses, retaining the distinction between generic AS and all closed fibers in the full fifteen-dimensional component.
